params.body:
## What

Removes the legacy `/statistics/{year?}` page (`home.statistics`).

It showed platform-wide yearly counts (vehicles created, sold and put on the stocklist, buy-overs, export vehicles, bidding winners, new dealers) to every user of dealer 4 and a 404 to everyone else. Nothing linked to it. The administrator's Insights screen now carries these figures, for the administrator only, so this page only exposed platform-wide numbers to every StockCars account.

## Removed

- the route in `routes/web.php`
- `HomeController::statistics()` and the imports only it used (`Dealer`, `Vehicle`, `Request`, `Carbon`)
- `resources/views/dashboard/statistics.blade.php` (no partials, JS, CSS or translation keys of its own)
- its PHPStan baseline entry (`$dealer_id` on `Authenticatable` in `HomeController`)
- its case in `SmokeTest`; two comments there used the route as the example of an optional parameter and now use `/access/{access?}`

No menu row, role access, seeder or business rule referred to the page, so no migration and no docs change. The quality ratchet budgets are unaffected.

## Test

`LegacyStatisticsPageRemovedTest`: the route name no longer exists, and `/statistics` and `/statistics/2026` return 404 for a user of dealer 4.

Full suite green locally (2469 tests), PHPStan clean.
params.title: Remove the legacy /statistics page
